items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: She had a whole lot of good records too, George. He was a good man.

ctx.x: A son and a daughter playing. I know his son is playing. I know his son, Lola, his wife they call her Lola.
Nola. That's George McCullin Jr. Yeah, that's right.
She had a whole lot of good records too, George. He was a good man. That man couldn't, the only way he played his horn he had to be drunk. He lost about nine horns on street cars.
